commentary.text: 90+5' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) earns the yellow card.
90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+3' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Girona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+2' Kike Garcia (Alaves) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Girona for a penalty. Play continues.
89' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to Antonio Blanco (Alaves), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
88' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

88' What a great chance for Santiago Mourino (Alaves). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
88' The ball goes out of play and Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
87' Antonio Sivera (Alaves) receives a yellow card for infringement.
84' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
83' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to Tomas Conechny (Alaves) for a tough tackle.
81' Eduardo Coudet has decided to substitute Carlos Martin and he is replaced by Tomas Conechny (Alaves).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Portu (Girona) comes onto the pitch for Miguel Gutierrez.

77' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.
76' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick goes way wide to the right. Poor shot!
75' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 13:8.
73' Eduardo Coudet has decided to make a change. Ander Guevara (Alaves) replaces Joan Jordan.
73' It's time for a substitution. Carles Alena (Alaves) comes on in place of Jon Guridi.
69' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
68' It will be a substitution. Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is ready to enter the pitch as Donny van de Beek walks off.
68' Michel prepares a substitution. Abel Ruiz is replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
68' Substitution. Oriol Romeu will be replaced by Arthur Melo (Girona).
65' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) sees a yellow card from Alejandro Ruiz after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
61' 0 - 1 Carlos Vicente (Alaves) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom left corner. Magnificent finish!
60' Girona have a corner.
59' A snap shot by Donny van de Beek (Girona) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Antonio Sivera produces a good save to thwart him.
58' Today's referee Alejandro Ruiz rightly decides to book Jon Guridi (Alaves) for his harsh tackle.
57' Carlos Martin (Alaves) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.
53' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
53' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Alaves.
51' Girona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
50' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
49' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Yangel Herrera (Girona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
40' 0:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
38' Joan Jordan (Alaves) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
35' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
35' Alejandro Ruiz blows the whistle, Joan Jordan (Alaves) is penalised for a foul.
32' A pass by Manu Sanchez (Alaves) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
29' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
28' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Antonio Sivera comes off the line to clear the ball away.
25' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
22' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the left post.
22' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Paulo Gazzaniga, who smothers the ball.
20' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 0:7.
18' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
13' Jon Guridi (Alaves) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

8' A sweet pass finds Kike Garcia (Alaves) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Paulo Gazzaniga is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
8' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
5' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.
3' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
1' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Paulo Gazzaniga intercepts the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Alaves will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Ruiz will referee today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
